title: v0.4.2 - Engine Refactoring & Critical Checks
description: Significant architectural improvements to the spreadsheet engine and critical bug fixes for data integrity.
items: Modularized Spreadsheet Engine - Split engine into specialized modules (Storage, Data, Change Tracking) for better maintainability
Fixed Column Deletion - Resolved issues where deleting columns failed to save to database or update UI correctly
Smart Auto-Save - Eliminated redundant save operations by implementing precise modification tracking
Robust Undo/Redo - Fixed async execution issues and infinite recursion in command history
Database Integrity - Prevented duplicate header rows and ensured schema changes are always saved
UI Enhancements - Fixed missing icons and improved deletion UX to prioritize column selection

title: v0.4.1 - Intelligent Data Management & Stability
description: Major stability improvements for Excel/Table operations, robust data handling, and infinite loop prevention.
items: Implemented 'Smart Table Cleanup' - automatically removes empty rows to keep databases clean
Added 'Hybrid Save Strategy' - intelligently switches between delta updates and full replacements for 100% data sync reliability
Fixed 'Analyze Table' feature - simplified credentials handling and improved error logging
Refined Delete behavior - Delete key now clears content (like Excel) instead of dropping columns, preventing DB errors
Fixed infinite save/refresh loops with intelligent state tracking
Resolved Light Mode issues - Pegasus logo now maintains brand color in all themes
Enhanced support for multi-column and multi-row data clearing

title: v0.5.0 - Professional Spreadsheet Features (Preview)
description: Making Pegasus a world-class spreadsheet application with essential UX features, power tools, and real-time collaboration foundation.
items: 🔄 Undo/Redo System - Full operation history with Ctrl+Z/Ctrl+Y support
🔍 Find & Replace - Search and replace across entire spreadsheet with Ctrl+F
📊 Export to Excel/CSV - Download your data in standard formats
⌨️ Enhanced Keyboard Shortcuts - F2 to edit, Ctrl+Arrow navigation, Ctrl+A select all
➕ Insert Column/Row - Add columns and rows anywhere in your spreadsheet
📏 Column Resize - Drag column borders to adjust width
🔽 Sort & Filter - Click headers to sort, filter data by values
🖱️ Context Menu - Right-click for quick access to common operations
💰 Number Formatting - Currency, percentage, date formatting
👥 Real-time Collaboration (Beta) - See other users' cursors and edits live

title: Custom Excel-like Spreadsheet Engine
description: Built from scratch: a powerful, Excel-like spreadsheet with formula support, AI-powered generation, and intelligent workspace management. No third-party dependencies—complete control and customization.
items: Custom formula engine with dependency tracking and automatic recalculation
Support for 50+ Excel functions: SUM, AVERAGE, IF, VLOOKUP, and more
Drag-to-fill with smart formula adjustment (relative references)
Real-time formula autocomplete with function suggestions
Visual formula reference highlighting with color-coded cells
AI-powered formula generation from natural language
Formula error detection and AI-powered debugging
Multi-tab workspace with isolated spreadsheet sessions
Persistent storage per tab with localStorage
Virtualized rendering for smooth performance with 1000+ rows

title: Workspace Tab Management
description: Professional multi-tab interface inspired by Excel and SQL Server Management Studio, with complete session isolation and persistence.
items: Create unlimited tabs: Chat, SQL Query, or Spreadsheet
Each tab maintains independent content and state
Tab-specific engine instances for spreadsheets
Automatic workspace state persistence across sessions
Visual tab icons and labels for easy identification
Quick tab switching with preserved scroll position and selection
Load database tables directly into new spreadsheet tabs
Duplicate detection prevents creating multiple tabs for same table

title: AI Formula Assistant
description: Generate complex Excel formulas using natural language. The AI understands your spreadsheet structure and creates accurate formulas with explanations.
items: Natural language to Excel formula conversion
Automatic spreadsheet analysis (headers, data types, sample rows)
Formula preview with reasoning and example results
Ambiguity detection with clarification dialogs
Data modification warnings before applying formulas
Auto-execute mode for instant formula application
Smart row adjustment when applying formulas to columns
Formula history saved to query history for reuse

title: Operation Cancellation
description: You can now cancel long-running queries and operations with a single click, giving you full control over your database interactions.
items: Cancel button appears in results panel during query execution
Stop button in toolbar for quick cancellation
Graceful cancellation using AbortController for clean resource cleanup
Toast notifications confirm when operations are cancelled
Prevents unnecessary backend load from unwanted queries

title: Enhanced AI Formula Generation
description: AI formula generation now supports a comprehensive library of Excel functions, including advanced mathematical and statistical operations.
items: Added rounding functions: ROUNDUP, ROUNDDOWN, ROUND, CEILING, FLOOR
Expanded math functions: ABS, POWER, SQRT
Text manipulation: CONCATENATE, LEFT, RIGHT, MID, LEN, TRIM, UPPER, LOWER, PROPER
Lookup functions: VLOOKUP, HLOOKUP, INDEX, MATCH, XLOOKUP
Date functions: TODAY, NOW, DATE, YEAR, MONTH, DAY, DATEDIF
Statistical functions: AVERAGEIF, SUMIF, COUNTIF, MEDIAN, MODE
AI now has explicit knowledge of 50+ Excel functions for better formula suggestions

title: Experimental Features System
description: Introducing a comprehensive experimental features system that allows users to request access to cutting-edge features and toggle them on/off in Settings.
items: Request experimental access from the Support page
Manage experimental features in Settings with toggle switches
WorkOS-style feature flags integrated with authentication
Three experimental features: Manual Excel Formulas, Advanced AI Modes, and Query Performance Insights
Feature flags persist across sessions and sync with user authentication
Admin approval workflow for experimental access requests

title: Formula Bar Now Experimental
description: The Excel-style formula bar is now an experimental feature. Users without experimental access see a clean, simple text input for basic data entry.
items: Default users get a simplified interface with basic text editing
Experimental users get the full Excel-style formula bar with autocomplete
Formula autocomplete, point mode, and AI controls gated behind feature flag
Progressive disclosure - advanced features available when needed
Cleaner default experience for new users

title: Query Tab Isolation & Results Panel
description: Query tabs now work like SQL Server Management Studio (SSMS) with complete content isolation and improved results display.
items: Each query tab maintains its own independent content
Loading queries from history creates new isolated tabs
Results panel now has transparent, modern aesthetic
Reduced visual clutter with subtle borders and hover effects
Better integration with dark mode and light mode themes

title: Formula History & Query Execution
description: Fixed critical issues with formula saving and query execution in isolated tabs.
items: AI-generated formulas now save actual Excel formulas (e.g., '=B2*C2') instead of natural language
Run button correctly executes queries from active tab content
Fixed crash when loading queries from history
Formula queries properly switch to spreadsheet mode with AI enabled

title: Support Page & Email Feedback System
description: We've added a dedicated support page where you can view the latest updates and send us feedback.
items: Priority-based feedback system with critical escalation
Weekly digest emails for non-urgent feedback
Automatic keyword detection for urgent issues
Experimental features request form
Real-time status updates for experimental access

title: Dashboard Management Enhancements
description: Improved dashboard management with better modals and notifications.
items: Modal dialogs for rename and delete operations
Toast notifications for all dashboard actions
Better light mode support across all UI components

title: Dashboard Sharing & Import
description: Share your dashboards with others and import shared dashboards via links.
items: Generate shareable links for dashboards
Import dashboards from shared links
Automatic duplicate title handling
